# CANDIDATE: VIX_RISING_FILTER_FOR_PUTS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX rising requirement for put entries will filter out false breakdowns where VIX is falling (indicating lack of fear), improving edge capture on J winner days while avoiding J loser days. This addresses the VIX confirmation context filter in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON by adding a dynamic character check (rising VIX) beyond the static level threshold.

## Mechanism

For PUT entries only: require current 1-minute VIX > VIX from 5 minutes ago at trigger bar close. Uses existing VIX feed in `lib/watchers/runner.py`. Entry blocked if VIX is flat or falling. No changes to exit logic or other filters. Integrated as additional condition in `evaluate_bearish_setup()` after existing VIX>20 check.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% risk cap and $0.50–$2.00 entry premium zone.
2. **Sample bias:** Using 6-day J sample (3 winners, 2 loser puts) for initial validation risks overfit to specific volatility regimes; walk-forward OOS required to mitigate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will run walk-forward on 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 with 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-21 held-out window post-Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days: 4/29, 5/01, 5/04) using cached OPRA with realistic slippage model.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: VIX rises then crashes mid-trade (e.g., 5/06) causing premature stop-out; 
   - Max drawdown: -$1,200 estimated from similar volatility filters; 
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent VIX decay regime (like 2025-Q3) causing chronic entry reduction and missed winners.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days currently contribute ~140% of P&L for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (per L04); this filter may increase concentration if it only works in specific VIX regimes.

## Pre-merge gate

- Stage-1 backtest via autoresearch grinder (min 100 combos) 
- Walk-forward OOS with Sharpe ≥0.70 and sub-window stability 
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days showing <±20% P&L deviation from BS sim 
- Gym validators pass (backtest/tests/test_vix_rising_filter.py) 
- OP-16 anchor no-regression (delta_edge_capture ≥ -$10 on J winners)

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- Based on VIX character lessons (L40,44,45,73,93,118,133,134,154,162,167) showing VIX trend matters more than level, but no direct backtest evidence for this specific filter.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

Complements [V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE] (rank 3) which filters structural mismatches; this adds temporal VIX dimension. No conflict with top candidates as it targets PUT entry quality. May conflict with [BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING] if both fire on same bar (would require OR logic testing).
